[[Jarimiya the Unmerciful]] is a [[Heket]] boss that appears in [[Vehtendi Valley]].

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Vehtendi Valley}} (not if [[Rally The Princes]] or [[Valley of the Rifts]] are active)

==Quests==
*[[Jarimiya the Unmerciful (Zaishen quest)]]

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Deadly Paradox}}
*{{skill icon|Disrupting Dagger}}
*{{skill icon|Lift Enchantment}}
*{{skill icon|Malicious Strike}}
*{{skill icon|Wastrel's Collapse}} ([[elite]])

==Items dropped==
*[[Bottle of Rice Wine]]
*[[Bottle of Vabbian Wine]]
*[[Heket Tongue]]
*[[Jarimiya's Daggers]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
* This boss always [[drop]]s one [[Bottle of Vabbian Wine]] when it dies, although it can be [[assign]]ed to [[NPC]]s, such as [[henchmen]], [[hero]]es or [[Vabbian Guard]]s (in which case you will not see the drop).
** All enemy groups between the [[portal]] to [[Forum Highlands]] and Jarimiya can be [[pull]]ed towards the nearby groups of Vabbian Guards for extra help when solo farming; this includes the group of [[Bohdalz the Furious]].

==Trivia==
* [[W:Hoyt Axton|Hoyt Axton]]'s song "[[Wikipedia:Joy to the World (Hoyt Axton song)|Joy to the World]]" mentions that ''"Jeremiah was a bullfrog"'' who ''"always had some mighty fine wine"''. Jarimiya the Unmerciful, the frog-like Heket boss, always drops Vabbian Wine.
